4.text:
<C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,><C:0001,0001,>～Volume 1～
[Peaceful Island, Folk of Mystery]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>Soft winds ever blow across Pi'illo Island,
whispering of lore and legend...<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>A strange people once made their home
here, and it is said they were possessed
of a mysterious power.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>What power, you ask, intrepid reader?
The power to slip through the veil that
separates the real and dream worlds.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>These were the Pi'illo folk for whom
this island is named, and under their
care, it was a flourishing paradise.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But time laughs at mortal works,
and now old ruins dotted about the
island are all that remains.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>What fate befell the inhabitants of
this island? How did their line falter?
Whence came their hidden end?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Consider these humble writings an
attempt to record all that is known
of the Pi'illos...and their end.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 2...
[Prince Dreambert]<C:0003,0001,>

6.text:
<C:0001,0001,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0004,>～Volume 2～
[Prince Dreambert]<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0000,>The Pi'illos were at the peak of their
prominence, and they were led by their
young ruler, Prince Dreambert.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The youthful leader's crowning 
achievement had been the construction
of Pi'illo Castle, a monumental edifice.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Though cast in stone, the structure
embodied the cultural and artistic
sensibilities of Dreambert's people.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>As any visitor can attest, the castle
still reflects both the prosperity and
the peaceful nature of the Pi'illo prince.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>But it reflects more. For it is said
that somewhere within is a strange
room... A snapshot of Pi'illo culture.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>By sleeping in this room, the legend
claims, one dreams of Pi'illo enemies
and can revel in their defeats.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>The Pi'illos were a tranquil people,
to be sure...but the prince bid all
soldiers hone their skills in this room.<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Did young Dreambert have a
premonition of evil times?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,>Did he foresee that some fell thing
would one day come with ruin in tow?<C:0003,0001,><C:0000,0004,><C:0007,0000,><C:0001,0001,>Continued in Volume 3...
[The Nightmare Begins]<C:0003,0001,>
